chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Maqarri narrated to us, saying: Abu Amr Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Maqarri al-Jarjani narrated to us, saying: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Mawsili in Baghdad narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Asim al-Tarifi narrated to us, saying: Abbas ibn Yazid ibn al-Hasan al-Kahhal, the freedman of Zayd ibn Ali, narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, saying: Musa ibn Ja'far narrated to me, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them all), saying:

The Imam from us is not but Infallible. Infallibility is not in the apparent disposition by which one is recognized, and therefore, he is not but affirmed (by text). It was said to him: O son of Allah's Messenger, then what is the meaning of an Infallible? He said: It is he who adheres to the Rope of Allah, and the Rope of Allah is the Qur'an; they do not separate until the Day of Resurrection. The Imam guides to the Qur'an, and the Qur'an guides to the Imam. That is the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is more upright.'
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between the Imam and the Qur'an according to Shia theology?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights that the Imam's infallibility is a spiritual station of being 'anchored to the Rope of God' (Quran), rather than a physical attribute, necessitating explicit designation (Nass). This establishes a dual hermeneutic where the Imam elucidates the Quran and the Quran authenticates the Imam, ensuring they remain inseparable until the Day of Judgment. This concept underscores the Shia belief in the Quran's need for an infallible interpreter to preserve its true meaning from distortion.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Abdul-Rahman al-Maqarri, that he said: We were told by Abu Amru and Muhammed bin Ja’far al-Maqarri al-Jarjani, that he said: We were told by Abu Bakr, Muhammed bin Hasan al-Mosuli, in Baghdad, that he said: We were told by Muhammed ibn ‘Asim al-Turayfi, that he said: We were told by Abbas bin Yazid bin Hasan al-Kahhal, the servant of Zaid bin Ali, that he said: I was told by my father, that he said: I was told by Musa bin Ja’far, from his father, Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, Muhammed bin Ali, from his father, Ali bin Hussain, peace be upon him, that he said:

The Imam from us is not but Infallible. Infallibility is not in the apparent disposition by which one is recognized, and therefore, he is not but affirmed. It was said to him: O son of Allah’s Messenger, then what is the meaning of an Infallible? He said: It is he who adheres to the Rope of Allah, and the Rope of Allah is the Qur’an; they do not separate until the Day of Resurrection. The Imam guides to the Qur’an, and the Qur’an guides to the Imam. That is the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Indeed, this Qur’an guides to that which is more upright.» [17:9]
